vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix is proposed at once, without the two-day delay.

packageRules.description: The NATS packages pin each other to an exact version: they move together.
The OpenTelemetry packages share peer ranges across their release lines.
The Testcontainers modules depend on the same version of the core package.
Patch, pin and digest updates merge on their own once CI is green.
Cadenway packages are proposed as soon as they are published.
TypeScript stays on 6.0 until typescript-eslint accepts a newer line.
